## Problem / Idea
Describe what you'd like to see in GraviHUD.

## Offline & Privacy Check
- [ ] This feature works **100% offline** with zero network requests and zero open ports.
- [ ] This feature does **not** inject into Antigravity, read credentials, or require Accessibility/Screen Recording permissions.
